chitchat: You are meant to be scared. Just so you know.
It itches. Nobody tells you it itches.
If you see Hale, I have been here the whole time.
description: A lanky fifteen-year-old propped against the gate frame with a bone mask shoved up onto the top of his head like a pair of goggles, radiating the specific boredom of somebody four hours into a six-hour shift. He straightens up when he notices you, gets the mask most of the way down, thinks better of it, and leaves it there.

bye.text: "Not the beds. Seriously, not the beds, I get it in the neck."

mask.text:
"It is padded. It is still hot." He pulls it off entirely and turns it over to show you, which somewhat undermines the point of it. The inside is quilted rag, stitched down flat at every edge in small even stitches. "My gran did the lining. She does everybody's. That seam there went last month and I got a lecture about it.

Six hours, twice a week. And you have to do the walk, up and down, so they see you moving. That is the worst bit. Anyone can stand still."

road.text:
"Before me." He says it the way you say a war. "Gran's, mostly, everyone says.

I hate it. Not the shift, I mean the road. You have to walk down it to get out and it is horrible, and I know exactly who made every bit of it and it is still horrible in the dark."

He kicks the gate frame.

"But my dad went over the wall at Coldwater and lives in a tenement now with two others and they are all right, and my gran says he only got the choice because nobody has ever come up that road with a rope. So."

A shrug. He has plainly had this argument with himself many times and lost it every time.

"So it is six hours. Twice a week."

root.first: He gets the mask halfway down, holds it there, and then gives up entirely and shoves it back onto his head. "Look, you have already seen my face, so." A shrug of magnificent adolescent fatalism. "Gate is open. Do not go in the beds. That is it, that is the whole speech."

options.label: You are supposed to have that on.
Vurn. I have heard that name.

root.text: The mask is on top of his head again. "Gate is open. Not the beds."

text_by_relation.close: He brightens up considerably. "Right, good, talk to me, I am dying here."
text_by_relation.familiar: "Tell me it is nearly the hour. Lie to me."
text_by_relation.known: "Oh, it is you." He does not even reach for the mask.

rotten.text:
"It is rotten." He is delighted to have this conceded. "Thank you. Nobody says that. Everybody says it is four hours."

He puts the mask back on his head, wrong way round.

"I want the tanks. Sill says not until I can do the numbers twice without checking, and I can do them once, so."

vurn.text: "Sledge. Sledge Vurn." He is unmistakably proud and trying not to be. "He is in the city. He sends things back sometimes, wire mostly, once a whole pump. Gran will not talk about it and Rindle will, so ask Rindle."

clothing_layers: a coat two sizes too big, taken in at the shoulders
a bone mask pushed up onto the top of his head
boots that were somebody else's first

name: Ossa Vurn
